people.name: Barnabas
people.line: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and some others of them, to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.
translations.bsb: And after engaging these men in sharp debate, Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.
translations.kjv: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
translations.asv: And when Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and questioning with them, the brethren appointed that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.
